data.raw_text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In view of Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrations on October 31, 2025, at various locations in New Delhi, vehicular and public movement will be restricted in and around the event areas.

📍 Affected Routes:
Ashoka Road, Sansad Marg, C-Hexagon, Mathura Road, Purana Qila Road & nearby connecting roads.

📍 Diversions & Restrictions:
* Traffic movement to be restricted at Patel Chowk, Rafi Marg, Kartavya Path & C-Hexagon during specified hours.
* Vehicles found parked in restricted zones will be towed.
* Commuters are advised to avoid Ashoka Road, Sansad Marg, C-Hexagon, Mathura Road & Pragati Maidan Tunnel.

#DTPUpdates
